decision.summary: No new action: the weekly 74k dip remains the live bearish thesis, and the remaining daily board is too late and too discounted for a clean fresh entry.
decision.rationale: BTC remains short-term bearish, but the only active position left is the weekly 74k dip, which is still the closest valid weekly bearish expression. With only about 4 hours until daily expiry, the remaining daily opportunities are poor: 74k dip is still too discounted around 10.9%, 78k reach is effectively dead around 3.4%, and there is no clean same-day setup strong enough to justify using a daily slot this late in the session. Reconciliation is healthy, but there is no valid edge to add here.
